usage.text:
The 1 kg weight falls onto one end of the seesaw at 0.80 s, rotating it and launching the 100 g ball from the other end. The ball leaves the seesaw at 0.89 s and reaches a peak height of 3.53 m at 1.55 s.

It started at 0.86 m, so it rises **2.67 m above its starting position**, comfortably exceeding the required 50 cm. It then falls to the floor and comes to rest.
